Involutive duality gives the lower-endpoint box criterion. Positive cuts give finite high-contribution support, all-depth attainment, product-topology continuity, and exact omitted-grade truncation error. All endpoint examples are explicit; finite checker uses exact fractions and tests 66,900 vectors plus 1,110 truncation configurations. No finite experiment is invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Witnessedness is essential to constructive semantics and to finite approximation of many-valued modal evaluation. The theorem identifies exactly when increasing the available atomic truth palette changes a fixed infinite frame from automatically witnessed to unwitnessed: finite palettes only see grade reverse well-order; accumulation at 1 controls possibility and accumulation at 0 independently controls necessity. The distinction is sharp on one frame, and the exact omitted-grade error quantifies the finite implementation boundary. This is a motivated structural criterion, not a gratuitous finite enumeration or a routine numerical increment.
